GBP/CHF FX cross 08/09/26 Long CHF 1.10 CHF 1.08 +2.78% - - +0.21
CHF 1.08stopCHF 1.12target
Thesis
The SNB caps the franc: rates at zero, and it sells francs when the currency runs. That is what protects the 3.75% sterling pays.
Catalyst
The MPC meets on 17 September. The market expects a rise, widening the gap this earns.
Breaks if
The Bank of England starts cutting, or the SNB stops selling francs into a rally.

Japan 225 Index 08/09/26 10/09/26 Long ¥66,333 ¥64,043 2 days +11.0% - -1.00
¥64,043stop¥70,970target
Thesis
AI chips are built and tested on Advantest and Tokyo Electron equipment. Price weighting makes the Nikkei the most concentrated way to own both.
Catalyst
The index had fallen 16% from its June high, then rose 2% on chip stocks in the session before this went on.
Breaks if
Semiconductor capex slows and the two chip names fall. Nothing else in the index is big enough to offset them.
Post-mortem
The thesis worked on a six-month horizon. The stop and target worked on a weekly one.
